evidence.says: Marcus Meer reviewed the History of Heralds II workshop held in Münster on 25–27 March 2015.
Marcus Meer lists organising that 2015 Münster workshop and his book Heraldry in Urban Society; he worked at Münster in 2014–2015.

basis: The reviewer and the author of the later book are linked by the same specifically dated Münster workshop and institution. The CV identifies the latter as an organiser of the event reviewed under the first key.
